title: Daily Twist: neon glass drums
story: Daily Twist at 123 BPM: four-on-the-floor tech house with a steady 16th hat texture. The build (4261-4761, eight bars) carries an escalating shake on the strongest hit of every beat (0.18 rising to 0.60 across the bars) while the panes get smaller bar by bar (celdas 9.0 to 14.4) and the bright claps deepen the neon glass. On the drop at 4761 the window goes to big grid panes with a blow-out (estallido 1.2), the claps keep their contrast-and-saturation hits and the prominent 9.36 hit at 4792 thickens the lead and lifts the light. After the anomaly the kick lights the glass (estallido 0.4), claps flip contrast and saturation, open hats thicken the lead, and every two bars the panes flip between grid and organic.
